name: Ken Calvert

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: ACCELERATING ACCESS TO CRITICAL THERAPIES FOR ALS REAUTHORIZATION ACT OF 2026
statements.title: ACCELERATING ACCESS TO CRITICAL THERAPIES FOR ALS REAUTHORIZATION ACT OF 2026
sentences: Mr. Speaker, I rise today in support of the ACT for ALS Reauthorization Act, H.R. 8205, legislation that will reauthorize programs that support research and development of drugs and other therapies to address ALS.
I urge all of my colleagues to stand with these families, give them hope, and pass the ACT for ALS Reauthorization Act.
